title: olmeca clarkiae
intro: Olmeca clarkiae, commonly known as the Mexican prickly poppy, is a flowering plant in the poppy family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Olmeca clarkiae include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and phenolic compounds, such as berberine and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
